article.headline: Queens beats Winthrop 103-98 as Jordan Watford scores 26
article.description: — Jordan Watford had 26 points in Queens’ 103-98 victory against Winthrop on Monday.
article.linkText: Queens beats Winthrop 103-98 as Jordan Watford scores 26
article.story: ROCK HILL, S.C. -- — Jordan Watford had 26 points in Queens’ 103-98 victory against Winthrop on Monday. Watford also had seven rebounds and eight assists for the Royals (1-0). Nasir Mann added 19 points while going 6 of 11 from the floor, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the line while they also had five rebounds. Isaiah Henry shot 6 of 9 from the field and 2 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Keshawn Fisher finished with 32 points, six rebounds, two steals and four blocks for the Eagles (0-1). Spence Sims added 19 points for Winthrop. George Natsvlishvili finished with 16 points and nine rebounds. Up next Queens’ next game is Wednesday against Loyola Marymount on the road, and Winthrop hosts North Dakota on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
